title: [LOGGED OUT] The French cookie banner button means the same as "Dismiss"
reason: French cookie banner button is labelled "Rejeter" (Reject), not a close/OK word

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/fr-FR in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
Is a banner titled "Comment nous utilisons les cookies" shown?
steps.saw: Banner titled "Comment nous utilisons les cookies" shown at the bottom of the page.

steps.text: Is the banner button labelled with a word that means "close" or "OK" (for example "Fermer" or "OK"), and not "Rejeter" (which means "Reject")?
steps.saw: The banner button is labelled "Rejeter" (French for Reject), not "Fermer" or "OK". The English banner uses "Dismiss", so the French label has a different meaning.
